summary.result: The model results showed that the correlation between observed and modelled soil moisture increased when using antecedent rainfalls before the soil moisture simulation day.
summary.background: For the modeling, the input data of COMS LST, Terra MODIS Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), daily rainfall and sunshine hour were considered and prepared.
summary.method: Using the observed soil moisture data at 9 stations of Automated Agriculture Observing System (AAOS) from January 2013 to May 2015, the MLRMs were developed by twelve scenarios of input components combination.

summary_ko.result: 모델 결과는 토양수분 모의일 전후의 강우량을 사용할 때 관측된 토양수분과 모의된 토양수분 간의 상관성이 증가하였다.
